title.en: MALACANANG PROVIDING FOR THE CREATION OF A BOARD OF ADVISORS FOR THE LAGUNA LAKE DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY

text.en:
There is hereby created a Board of Advisors for the
Laguna Lake Development Authority (LLDA) which shall be composed of
three (3) representatives of the fisherfolk from the Laguna Lake area to be
appointed by the President.

The Board of Advisors shall provide advice to the Board
of Directors of the LLDA and shall attend all meetings of the Board of

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately upon
City of Manila, March 04, 2002
By the President:
PMS LIBRARY
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
